name: ai-canvas-cloud
description: Cloud SaaS monorepo for AI Canvas.
author: AI Canvas

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/shared && npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/project-graph && npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/server && npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/api && npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/admin-api && npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/web && npm run build -w @ai-canvas-cloud/admin-web
scripts.deploy:staging:check: npm run build --workspace @ai-canvas-cloud/shared && node scripts/check-deployment-config.mjs --env-file infra/deploy/staging/staging.env
scripts.deploy:staging:gate: npm run test && npm run db:migrate:test && npm run db:migrate:compat && npm run build && node scripts/staging-release-gate.mjs --env-file infra/deploy/staging/staging.env
scripts.deploy:staging:backup: docker compose --env-file infra/deploy/staging/staging.env -f infra/deploy/staging/docker-compose.yml run --rm backup-scheduler node scripts/create-staging-backup.mjs
